note: Each card is one possible mitosis: clicked, found by the detector, or both (see the label). Decide whether it is a division (1 = division, 2 = not a division, 3 = unsure; the keys move to the next card) and type anything else in the notes box (n jumps there). Labels marked 'suggested' are the detector's hints, not calls. Channels: H2B red (AF594), ZO1 green (AF488), each stretched to the card. Tick any mitotic errors you see (optional -- notes work too) and type the metaphase frame (Fiji numbering).
